# Error reference

Every rejection carries a code, a source span, and a `help:` line with a rewrite. This page
explains each code. The list is generated from the validator's code table, so it always matches
the compiler; a test fails if a code is missing here.

```text
error[CS1221]: `toFixed` on a number is not supported yet
  --> format.ts:2:31
  help: build the string form manually, or use `.toString()` / template interpolation
```

## CS0001: TypeScript error {#cs0001}

The program does not typecheck under the strict options ChadScript imposes (`strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, `noImplicitOverride`, `noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature`). TypeScript's checker decides every type, so a program with any type error is not compiled. Importing a name that a built-in module (`node:fs`, `node:path`) does not provide in the subset also lands here, because `stdlib/globals.d.ts` only declares what is supported.

**Rewrite:** Fix the type error tsc reports. The message after the code is tsc's own.

**Rejection tests:** [`const-reassign.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/const-reassign.ts), [`fs-promises-unsupported-export.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/fs-promises-unsupported-export.ts), [`main.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-type-without-type-keyword/main.ts) and 2 more

## CS1000: Not in the subset {#cs1000}

The general rejection. The compiler accepts a construct only when it has a rule for it, backed by a test that checks the result against Node; anything else stops here. The message names the construct (for example `GetAccessor`, a method in an object literal, top-level `await`, a nested `function` declaration, an optional chain longer than one `?.`).

**Rewrite:** Follow the `help:` line, which is specific to the construct. The [subset reference](/reference/subset) lists every admitted syntax kind.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`bigint-literal.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/bigint-literal.ts), [`call-spread-library.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/call-spread-library.ts), [`class-extends-error.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/class-extends-error.ts) and 22 more

## CS1201: `any` {#cs1201}

`any` switches off the type checker, and the compiler needs a static type for every value to choose its representation.

**Rewrite:** Give the value a concrete type, or a union of the types it can hold.

**Rejection tests:** [`any-annotation.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/any-annotation.ts)

## CS1202: `enum` {#cs1202}

TypeScript enums generate a runtime object with reverse mappings; they are not in the subset.

**Rewrite:** Use a union of string literals (`type Color = "red" | "green"`) or an `as const` object.

**Rejection tests:** [`enum-decl.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/enum-decl.ts)

## CS1203: `==` and `!=` {#cs1203}

Loose equality applies JavaScript's coercion table; the subset only has strict equality.

**Rewrite:** Use `===` / `!==`. To test for both `null` and `undefined`, write both comparisons.

**Rejection tests:** [`loose-eq.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/loose-eq.ts), [`loose-neq.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/loose-neq.ts)

## CS1204: Non-null assertion `x!` {#cs1204}

Node erases `x!` without a check. It is admitted only where it changes no representation (a no-op on a `Value` word); elsewhere it would need a representation change that Node never performs.

**Rewrite:** Narrow explicitly: `if (x !== undefined) { ... }`, or use `x ?? fallback`.

**Rejection tests:** [`non-null.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/non-null.ts)

## CS1205: `as any` / `as unknown` {#cs1205}

Casting through `any` or `unknown` escapes the type system.

**Rewrite:** Narrow the value with `typeof`, `instanceof` or a discriminant instead.

**Rejection tests:** [`as-any.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/as-any.ts)

## CS1206: `delete` {#cs1206}

Objects have a fixed shape after allocation; removing a property would change it at run time.

**Rewrite:** Model optional presence with an optional field (`x?: T`) or use a `Map`.

**Rejection tests:** [`delete-op.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/delete-op.ts)

## CS1207: Index signatures {#cs1207}

`{ [k: string]: T }` describes an object whose keys are only known at run time, which the static shape model cannot lay out.

**Rewrite:** Use `Map<string, T>` for dynamic keys.

**Rejection tests:** [`index-sig.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/index-sig.ts)

## CS1208: Decorators {#cs1208}

Decorators run arbitrary code against classes at definition time.

**Rewrite:** Call the wrapping function explicitly.

## CS1209: `namespace` / `module` blocks {#cs1209}

TypeScript namespaces create runtime objects; the subset uses ES modules only.

**Rewrite:** Split the code into files and use `import` / `export`.

**Rejection tests:** [`namespace-decl.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/namespace-decl.ts)

## CS1210: `with` {#cs1210}

`with` makes name resolution dynamic.

**Rewrite:** Access the properties explicitly.

## CS1211: `eval` / `new Function` {#cs1211}

There is no interpreter in a compiled binary, so code cannot be created at run time.

**Rewrite:** Write the function directly. Programs that need `eval` should run on Node.

**Rejection tests:** [`eval-call.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/eval-call.ts)

## CS1212: `var` {#cs1212}

`var` hoists to function scope; the subset uses block-scoped bindings only.

**Rewrite:** Use `let` or `const`.

**Rejection tests:** [`var-keyword.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/var-keyword.ts)

## CS1213: Regular expressions {#cs1213}

Regex literals and `RegExp` are not in the subset yet.

**Rewrite:** Use string methods (`includes`, `indexOf`, `split`, `replace` with a string pattern).

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`regex-literal.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/regex-literal.ts)

## CS1214: `JSON.parse` form {#cs1214}

`JSON.parse` must have a declared target type, because the compiler checks the parsed document against it (and throws on a mismatch). The reviver argument, and targets that mix object types with other kinds in one union, are not supported.

**Rewrite:** Annotate the target: `const cfg: Config = JSON.parse(text);`. See [JSON](/guide/json).

**Rejection tests:** [`json-parse-object-union.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/json-parse-object-union.ts), [`json-parse-reviver.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/json-parse-reviver.ts), [`json-parse-unannotated.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/json-parse-unannotated.ts) and 1 more

## CS1215: `Date` {#cs1215}

Only `Date.now()` is in the subset; `Date` instances need calendar arithmetic that has not landed.

**Rewrite:** Use `Date.now()` (epoch milliseconds).

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`date-new.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/date-new.ts), [`date-parse.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/date-parse.ts)

## CS1216: UTF-16 dependent string operation {#cs1216}

Strings are stored as UTF-8. Operations whose result depends on UTF-16 code units (`charCodeAt`, `s[i]`, `for...of` over a string, `<` on strings, non-ASCII literals) would diverge from Node for non-ASCII text, so they are gated until the Unicode decision in the plan.

**Rewrite:** Use `charAt(i)` or `at(i)`, compare strings with `===`, and keep literals ASCII for now.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`string-charcodeat.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/string-charcodeat.ts), [`string-for-of.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/string-for-of.ts), [`string-fromcharcode.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/string-fromcharcode.ts) and 4 more

## CS1217: Optional or default parameter {#cs1217}

Optional (`x?`) and default (`x = v`) parameters are not supported yet.

**Rewrite:** Declare `x: T | undefined` and pass `undefined` explicitly, then apply the default in the body: `const v = x ?? DEFAULT`.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`param-default.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/param-default.ts), [`param-optional.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/param-optional.ts)

## CS1218: Declaration without initializer {#cs1218}

`let x: T;` without a value is not supported yet.

**Rewrite:** Initialize at the declaration: `let x: T = initial;`.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`uninit-var.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/uninit-var.ts)

## CS1220: Unsupported static method {#cs1220}

A static on a built-in namespace (`Array.*`, `Number.*`, `Object.*`, `Promise.*`, ...) that is not on the allowlist. The message lists the supported ones.

**Rewrite:** Use a supported static or write the loop. The [subset reference](/reference/subset#supported-namespace-statics) lists them.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`array-from.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/array-from.ts), [`math-hypot.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/math-hypot.ts), [`number-issafeinteger-unsupported.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/number-issafeinteger-unsupported.ts) and 3 more

## CS1221: Unsupported number method {#cs1221}

`toFixed`, `toPrecision` and `toExponential` are not supported yet.

**Rewrite:** Use `String(n)`, template interpolation, or round first: `Math.round(n * 100) / 100`.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`number-toexponential.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/number-toexponential.ts), [`number-tofixed.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/number-tofixed.ts), [`number-toprecision.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/number-toprecision.ts)

## CS1222: Unsupported `Map` / `Set` operation {#cs1222}

A `Map`/`Set` method outside the allowlist (for example `entries`), iterating a `Map` directly with `for...of`, or keeping an iterator from `keys()` / `values()` as a value.

**Rewrite:** Iterate keys and read values: `for (const k of m.keys()) { const v = m.get(k); }`, or snapshot with `[...m.keys()]`.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`collection-iterator-held.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/collection-iterator-held.ts), [`for-of-map.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/for-of-map.ts), [`log-map-iterator.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/log-map-iterator.ts)

## CS1223: Unsupported string method {#cs1223}

A `String.prototype` method outside the allowlist. The message lists the supported ones.

**Rewrite:** Use a supported method; the [subset reference](/reference/subset#supported-string-methods) lists them.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`string-normalize.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/string-normalize.ts)

## CS1224: Unsupported array method {#cs1224}

An `Array.prototype` method outside the allowlist. The message lists the supported ones.

**Rewrite:** Use a supported method; the [subset reference](/reference/subset#supported-array-methods) lists them.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`array-fill.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/array-fill.ts)

## CS1225: Method call on an unsupported receiver {#cs1225}

Calling a method on a value whose type is neither a class instance nor an interface or object type.

**Rewrite:** Call methods on class instances, or on objects typed by an interface or object type.

## CS1226: Unsupported module form {#cs1226}

An import or export the module system does not support: CommonJS (`require`, `export =`), dynamic `import()`, a package that ships only JavaScript and declarations, a namespace import used as a value, `export * as ns`, or an anonymous default class.

**Rewrite:** Use static ESM imports and named or default exports. A package must ship its TypeScript source. See [Modules](/guide/modules).

**Rejection tests:** [`main.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-cycle/main.ts), [`main.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-dts-package/main.ts), [`module-dynamic-import.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-dynamic-import.ts) and 6 more

## CS1227: Duplicate class name {#cs1227}

Reserved for two classes in one program that share a name.

**Rewrite:** Rename one of them.

**Status:** reserved. No validator rule emits this code today.

## CS1228: Module variable read before its declaration runs {#cs1228}

A function reads a module-level variable, and code that calls the function runs before the declaration. Node throws `ReferenceError` there (the temporal dead zone).

**Rewrite:** Move the declaration above the code that runs first.

**Rejection tests:** [`class-tdz.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/class-tdz.ts), [`module-var-tdz-via-callback.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-var-tdz-via-callback.ts), [`module-var-tdz-via-method.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-var-tdz-via-method.ts) and 2 more

## CS1229: `process.argv` form {#cs1229}

`argv[0]` and `argv[1]` are the node binary and the script path, which have no equivalent in a compiled binary. Only `process.argv.slice(2)` means the same thing in both.

**Rewrite:** Write `const args = process.argv.slice(2);` and index into `args`.

**Rejection tests:** [`argv-whole-array.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/argv-whole-array.ts)

## CS1230: Recursive type {#cs1230}

Reserved for types that refer to themselves. Recursive types such as trees and linked lists compile today.

**Rewrite:** Nothing to rewrite.

**Status:** reserved. No validator rule emits this code today.

## CS1231: Async timer callback {#cs1231}

TypeScript accepts `setTimeout(async () => ...)`, but a rejection inside it would have nothing to await it.

**Rewrite:** Make the callback synchronous, or have it call an async function whose promise you handle.

**Rejection tests:** [`timer-async-callback.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/timer-async-callback.ts)

## CS1232: Async function used as a value {#cs1232}

An `async function` declaration referenced without calling it.

**Rewrite:** Wrap it: `(x) => f(x)`.

**Rejection tests:** [`fn-ref-async.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/fn-ref-async.ts), [`main.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-imported-async-fn-value/main.ts), [`main.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/module-namespace-async-fn-value/main.ts)

## CS1233: Type with no representation {#cs1233}

A value whose type the value domain cannot represent: a tuple with different element types, an empty `never[]` literal, a union no runtime tag can tell apart (two array types), or a union used as a `Map`/`Set` key.

**Rewrite:** Follow the `help:` line: usually an object with named fields, or an explicit element type.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`empty-array-no-type.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/empty-array-no-type.ts), [`never-narrowed-read.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/never-narrowed-read.ts), [`promise-of-null.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/promise-of-null.ts) and 3 more

## CS1234: Opaque handle used as a value {#cs1234}

A runtime handle (a timer id, a promise) used as anything but a stored or passed value.

**Rewrite:** Only store it, pass it, or give it back to the API that made it (`clearTimeout(id)`).

**Rejection tests:** [`timer-handle-interpolated.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/timer-handle-interpolated.ts), [`timer-handle-printed.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/timer-handle-printed.ts), [`timer-handle-stringified.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/timer-handle-stringified.ts)

## CS1235: Property added at run time {#cs1235}

A write that can add a property to an object created without it. Objects keep the shape they were allocated with.

**Rewrite:** Create the object with the property (initialized to `undefined` if needed).

**Rejection tests:** [`json-parse-optional-write.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/json-parse-optional-write.ts), [`property-add.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/property-add.ts)

## CS1236: Too many layouts at one site {#cs1236}

A spread or `Object.values` that can see objects of too many runtime layouts, or an object made by `JSON.parse` whose key order is only known at run time.

**Rewrite:** Copy the fields you need explicitly: `{ a: src.a, b: src.b }`.

**Rejection tests:** [`json-parse-spread.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/json-parse-spread.ts), [`object-values-mixed-layouts.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/object-values-mixed-layouts.ts), [`spread-layout-limit.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/spread-layout-limit.ts)

## CS1237: Method implementations disagree on machine types {#cs1237}

A call through an interface where the implementations reachable at run time take or return different machine representations.

**Rewrite:** Give the implementations the same parameter and return types.

**Rejection tests:** [`method-representation-mismatch.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/method-representation-mismatch.ts)

## CS1238: Value that cannot be printed {#cs1238}

`console.log`, `JSON.stringify` or a format directive given a value that can hold something the runtime cannot render the way Node does (for example a promise).

**Rewrite:** Print the fields you need, or await the promise first.

**Rejection tests:** [`format-d-tostring.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/format-d-tostring.ts), [`format-dynamic-function.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/format-dynamic-function.ts), [`format-o-function.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/format-o-function.ts) and 9 more

## CS1239: Operation on an un-narrowed union {#cs1239}

An operation such as `x + 1` or `x.length` on a union of different kinds. Printing, `String()`, templates, `===`, `typeof`, `??` and truthiness work on any union; everything else needs one kind.

**Rewrite:** Narrow first: `if (typeof x === "number") { x + 1 }`.

**Rejection tests:** [`union-for-of.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/union-for-of.ts), [`union-member-access.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/union-member-access.ts)

## CS1240: Representation mismatch {#cs1240}

A flow whose nested elements differ in representation, for example passing a `number[]` where a `(number | string)[]` is expected. Both would alias one array, and writes through the wider type would break the narrower one.

**Rewrite:** Copy into a new array of the wider type (`[...xs]` with an annotation), or use one element type throughout.

**Rejection tests:** [`array-callback-optional-param.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/array-callback-optional-param.ts), [`array-covariance-representation.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/array-covariance-representation.ts), [`generic-array-alias.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/generic-array-alias.ts) and 4 more

## CS1241: Stale narrowing of a captured variable {#cs1241}

A variable that a closure reassigns is read with a narrowed type after a call. The call may have run the closure, so tsc's narrowing can be stale.

**Rewrite:** Copy the value into a `const` before the call and use the copy.

**Rejection tests:** [`stale-narrowing.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/stale-narrowing.ts)

## CS1242: Generic instantiated with a container or function {#cs1242}

Generics are compiled once with each type parameter as one self-describing word. An array, map or function type argument does not fit in that word.

**Rewrite:** Wrap it in an object (`{ items: xs }`), or write a non-generic function for that type.

**Status:** planned to be admitted in a later phase.

**Rejection tests:** [`generic-container-type-arg.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/generic-container-type-arg.ts)

## CS1243: Type-level computation {#cs1243}

Conditional, mapped, indexed-access and `keyof` types are not supported.

**Rewrite:** Write the resulting type out as an interface or a union of literals.

**Rejection tests:** [`generic-conditional-type.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/generic-conditional-type.ts), [`generic-keyof.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/generic-keyof.ts)

## CS1244: Constructor type {#cs1244}

`new () => T`: generic code cannot construct its type parameter.

**Rewrite:** Pass a factory function instead: `make: () => T`.

**Rejection tests:** [`generic-constructor-type.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/generic-constructor-type.ts)

## CS1246: Built-in function used as a value {#cs1246}

A built-in such as `String`, `Math.floor` or `console.log` passed as a value.

**Rewrite:** Wrap it in an arrow function: `xs.map((x) => String(x))`.

**Rejection tests:** [`builtin-member-as-value.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/builtin-member-as-value.ts), [`builtin-value-unsupported.ts`](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/blob/main/tests/fixtures/reject/builtin-value-unsupported.ts)

## CS9000: Internal compiler error {#cs9000}

A program passed the validator but a later stage could not compile it. This is always a compiler bug: the validator should have admitted the construct fully or rejected it with a code from this page.

**Rewrite:** Please [open an issue](https://github.com/cs01/ChadScript/issues) with the smallest program that triggers it. Until it is fixed, rewrite the construct named in the message.
